# Chapter 5: Advanced Training Practices

Traditional resistance training practices form the cornerstone of human muscle development. However, as one gains training experience, he or she can employ more advanced training practices to maximize individual genetic hypertrophic potential. These strategies generally allow increases in volume and intensity of load, primarily through the use of heavier loads, prolonging set duration, or both. In some instances, the strategies may also enhance hypertrophic mechanisms (mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage) over and above what is possible through traditional resistance training practices.
